versions.text: Law 27/2022 on Personal Data Protection enacted. Controllers and processors have a two-year transition period to comply. Health data is classified as specific personal data.

The transition period has ended and PDP Law obligations apply in full. Breach notification within 3x24 hours, data protection impact assessments for high-risk processing including specific personal data at scale, and conditions on cross-border transfers are enforceable. Implementing government regulations and the supervisory agency are still being finalised.

Amendments to the Personal Data Protection Act 2010 tabled in Parliament, proposing breach notification, data portability, mandatory data protection officers and replacement of the transfer whitelist.
Personal Data Protection (Amendment) Act 2024 gazetted. Provisions commence in phases, with breach notification and data protection officer duties following once guidelines are issued.

sample_founder_text: Nadi Health Sdn Bhd (Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia). Seed-stage healthtech startup, 11 staff, raised MYR 2.4m seed. Product: Nadi Triage, an AI assistant that reads patient intake forms and vital signs to prioritise emergency department queues and flag sepsis risk for clinicians. Processes patient names, symptoms, vitals and medical history; hosted on a cloud region in Singapore. Deployed in 3 private hospitals in Selangor. Business model: SaaS licence per hospital bed per year. Team: 6 engineers (2 Malaysian, 1 Indonesian), 2 clinicians, 3 commercial. Goal: establish a presence in Indonesia, run a pilot with private hospitals in Jakarta, and hire local ML engineers. Trademark 'Nadi' registered with MyIPO. No Indonesian entity yet. Unsure whether the product is a medical device in Indonesia.
